text:
adele.sec: noticed an unexpected external principal on the Vault transit wrapping key during a routine RBAC sweep. looks like partner-replicator@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com was granted encrypt/decrypt on `keyRing=transit, key=wrap-key`.
omar.ops: confirmed in admin audit: SetIamPolicy by user partner-admin@partner-prod.com on 2026-03-20. Data Access logs for KMS were never enabled on this keyring so we don't have encrypt/decrypt activity.

zane.eng: that's bad. immediate steps?

adele.sec: propose quick plan: 1) remove external binding (record command) 2) create a temporary wrap key (`wrap-temp-3456789012`) with strict IAM (vault + svc-rewrap only) 3) enable KMS Data Access logs -> sink to security BigQuery 4) canary rewrap one partner object, verify checksums 5) full rewrap in maintenance window, rotate any SA creds with access 6) enforce terraform-managed IAM + guardrail.

omar.ops: removal command I will run and paste output here for audit: ```gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding wrap-key --location=global --keyring=transit --member='serviceAccount:partner-replicator@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'```

zane.eng: will create `wrap-temp-3456789012` and a rewrap script. prefer not to do in-place streaming for big archives; will decrypt->encrypt stream preserving metadata. sample canary: ```OBJ=gs://partner-backups/daily/2026-03-20.tar.gz.enc
gsutil cp "$OBJ" - | gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=transit --key=wrap-key --ciphertext-file=- --plaintext-file=- | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=transit --key=wrap-temp-3456789012 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | gsutil cp - "$OBJ".rewrap && gsutil mv "$OBJ".rewrap "$OBJ"```

secbot: incident created INC-20260320-72. tasks assigned: remove binding (omar.ops), create temp key + rewrap canary (zane.eng), enable Data Access + sink (omar.ops), forensic timeline (adele.sec).

infra-oncall: maintenance window tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. can do full rewrap then. I'll be available for the canary if scheduled earlier.

adele.sec: after canary we'll snapshot CRC32C/MD5 and check Vault wrap success rates. if >3% failures in 5m rollback vault wrap config to old key. also rotate any SA keys shown in audit output.

omar.ops: enabled Data Access logs and created sink `kms_audit_sink` to security bigquery. posted sink creation command to infra PR.

zane.eng: temp key created: projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-temp-3456789012. will open terraform PR to add the key and the strict IAM binding. starting canary now, will paste results.

adele.sec: thanks. post all commands & outputs here so we have an in-thread audit trail. escalate to Legal if we find evidence of decrypted exports.
